name: okf
description: Agent skills for the Open Knowledge Format (OKF): write OKF bundles from sources the agent can read, and answer from bundles with provenance, trust, freshness, and attestation checks.

interface.shortDescription: Write and read OKF knowledge bundles
interface.longDescription: Use okf-generate to write, update, or validate an Open Knowledge Format bundle from sources that you can read. Use okf-consume to answer questions from a bundle and to report the trust tier, freshness, and attestation status of each concept that the answer uses.
defaultPrompt: Write an OKF bundle that documents this dataset.
Answer from this OKF bundle and report the trust of each concept.
